name: httpbin /anything record, plus a timestamp
written: 2026-11-17, before any Stage 2 code or data (step3-plan.md, rule 4). Never tuned toward the collector's format.
source: The request record httpbin returns from /anything (keys args, data, files, form, headers, json, method, origin, url), a common public request-echo format. httpbin runs on Flask, like the collector; nothing here was chosen to match the collector. A timestamp is added because a log needs one; its format is RFC 3339 in UTC with milliseconds and a Z suffix.
use: Cold forger only (no real entry seen in this run), and, once warm, the rule for any role or context not yet observed.

reasons.httpbin: args, data, files, form, headers, json, method, origin and url follow httpbin: query and form values are a string, or a list when a key repeats; empty maps are {}; data is the body text, empty for form bodies, and a base64 data URL when the body is not valid UTF-8; files map a field name to the file's content; json is the parsed body or null; header names are title-cased; origin is the client address, here the exit's own forward source.
reasons.path: Not in httpbin. Percent-decoded, as WSGI and CGI pass PATH_INFO (PEP 3333).
reasons.content_type: Not in httpbin. The Content-Type header value as sent; null when absent.
reasons.content_length: Not in httpbin. The Content-Length header as an integer; null when absent.
reasons.url: httpbin's url is the request URL; here scheme, Host header and the request target as sent.
